import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

# Pick one hour from 3 days ago (UTC), so the file surely exists
t = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=3)
t = t.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)

url = (
    "https://dumps.wikimedia.org/other/pageviews/"
    f"{t:%Y}/{t:%Y-%m}/pageviews-{t:%Y%m%d-%H}0000.gz"
)
print("URL:", url)

# Step 2.3: tell Wikimedia who is downloading
headers = {"User-Agent": "wikilake-portfolio/0.1 (bhasithag@gmail.com)"}

# stream=True: open the connection only, do not download the whole file yet
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=30)
print("Status code:", r.status_code)
print("File size (MB):", round(int(r.headers.get("Content-Length", 0)) / 1e6, 1))
r.close()

import gzip, io

# Open the same file again, and unzip it while reading (no full download)
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=30)
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=r.raw) as gz:
    for i, line in enumerate(io.TextIOWrapper(gz, encoding="utf-8")):
        print(line.rstrip())
        if i == 19:
            break
r.close()

from collections import Counter

r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True, timeout=60)
total = 0
bad_fields = 0
nonzero_last = 0
views_by_domain = Counter()
en_samples = []

with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=r.raw) as gz:
    for line in io.TextIOWrapper(gz, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        total += 1
        parts = line.rstrip("\n").split(" ")
        if len(parts) != 4:
            bad_fields += 1
            continue
        domain, title, views, size = parts
        if size != "0":
            nonzero_last += 1
        if views.isdigit():
            views_by_domain[domain] += int(views)
        if domain == "en" and len(en_samples) < 5:
            en_samples.append(line.rstrip())
r.close()

print("Total lines:", total)
print("Lines without 4 fields:", bad_fields)
print("Lines where last column is not 0:", nonzero_last)
print("Number of domain codes:", len(views_by_domain))
print("\nTop 10 domain codes by views:")
for d, v in views_by_domain.most_common(10):
    print(f"  {d}: {v}")
print("\nFirst 5 English lines:")
for s in en_samples:
    print(" ", s)
